images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished single gameplay concept screenshot for the Chinese 2D narrative tavern game 《致未归的客人》. Landscape 16:9 approximately 1536x864. Input image 1 is the existing guest portrait: preserve this person's appearance, costume and painterly face in a SMALL inset. Input image 2 is existing game interface: match its warm painted Western harbor tavern, dark walnut wood, antique brass, parchment panels, Chinese serif type, warm realistic brush texture, subtle carved borders. This is a PLAYABLE-looking game screen, not a poster, not a menu and not a collage. Main gameplay must dominate 70% of screen; clear light parchment and dark text, high readability, restrained ornamentation. No hands, no modern plastic, no neon, no mobile monetization. Label bottom small “玩法概念 · 参数待试玩”. Only requested short Chinese copy; do not invent extra tiny illegible text.
Primary request: Milo’s game “把路画到家”, a calm top-down pencil route puzzle on a folded paper map lying on a tavern table. Show a clear 5 by 5 board subtly integrated with hand-painted roads, harbor railway depot bottom left, village inn top right, hills and a river, an unreliable rainy bridge marked with a red crossed bridge icon. One continuous ochre pencil path has been dragged from depot towards inn via a little water well, using orthogonal grid segments; a circular pencil cursor at unfinished endpoint. Illustrated cart token at start, little horseshoe icons on a secondary narrow footpath. The puzzle is about checking rain detours and water stops, not joining all colors or filling every tile. Surround board only with one compass, ruler, folded correction slip and envelope. Layout: header “把路画到家” and subheading “米洛 · 雨天的货车”; upper right small “返回手帐 Esc”; right side narrow pale task card with Milo small portrait and 3 lines “经过水井” “避开断桥” “送达驿站”, checkmark next to first, empty marks next two. Bottom light tip ribbon “拖动铅笔画路线 · 空格试走 · 右键退一格”. One brass bordered small badge “第 2 页 / 3”. The view conveys an inviting handmade route puzzle and a world with useful places, vivid warm ochre/teal landscape.

Primary request: Ada’s minigame “慢半拍的下午”, a calm auditory sequence memory game at a watchmaker’s desk, not a complex circuit game. Main playfield is a large open brass pocket watch in the upper middle of soft green felt on walnut desk; its delicate gears and second hand are lovingly rendered. Below watch, FOUR large separate shallow brass component dishes in an evenly spaced horizontal row: left a coiled mainspring, next a large brass gear, next a silver watch case, right a brass chime tongue. A soft pale-gold ring currently illuminates gear tray, with a tiny drawn vibration wave, indicating the sound being demonstrated. Right narrow panel Ada small portrait faithful to reference, small note “第 2 段 / 3”, large clear current status “先听这一段”. Bottom light ribbon “观察亮起的零件 · 按顺序点击 · 空格重听”. An open daylight window suggests a peaceful ranch and a stopped schedule note, soft harbor afternoon blue outside. A cup of pale transparent drink far corner, repair loupe and one small screwdriver stowed neatly. No countdown, no score pressure, no hands. Focus on brass textures and a comfortable unhurried afternoon.

Primary request: Hank’s minigame “风里还有一盏灯”, a simple three-position timing game presented as an old community tabletop shadow-theater of a sandstorm rescue. Main gameplay is a wide painted shallow wooden stage with three clearly separated travel lanes left-to-right, stacked top/middle/bottom, and a warm sheltered depot building at right. Each lane has one dark narrow crossing near center; silhouettes of traveler with baggage moving from left to right towards safe lit depot. ONE player-controlled lantern mounted on a vertical slider at center can occupy three stacked brass positions aligned to the three crossing gaps. It is currently at middle position, illuminating middle gap in soft fan of amber light so a traveler can cross. Dim ghost brass hooks at upper and lower positions show where lantern may move, not three simultaneously lit lamps. Need simple understandable lanes, NOT route drawing, NOT complex branching maze. Rope helper silhouettes are visible by left departure area; oil/shop helper by right depot, community cooperation visual. Dust gently sweeps across upper and lower lanes, no horror, no fire disaster, no weapons. Header “风里还有一盏灯”; subheading “老霍克 · 接人回家”; top right “返回手帐 Esc”. Left/right small reserved paper scoreboard “已接回 3 / 6” and “等灯 1 人”. Hank small portrait in bottom right aside, white mustache matches reference. A little midlane yellow waiting icon just before crossing indicates next target. Bottom light ribbon “鼠标移动灯位 · ↑↓切换 · 看见招手就照过去”. Small caption on stage “玛莎的灯 · 齐恩的油 · 尼尔的路”. Warm dark turquoise dust and amber lights, high contrast safe silhouettes, nostalgic Game-and-Watch readable simplicity rendered with the existing game's hand-painted realistic materials.

images.file: 米洛-把路画到家-渡河谜题概念.png
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished single 16:9 gameplay concept screenshot for the Chinese 2D narrative tavern game 《致未归的客人》. Image 1 is existing Milo portrait, keep appearance in small right inset. Image 2 existing UI: match warm hand-painted Western harbor, parchment cards, dark walnut, antique brass trim, readable Chinese serif text. This is a simple classic river crossing puzzle, NOT a map line puzzle.
Game title “把路画到家” and subtitle “米洛 · 雨后渡口”. A wide top-down oblique illustrated river spans middle of gameboard. Broad safe shore left and shore right. Small flat-bottom cable ferry at LEFT dock near lower middle. River has one fixed guide cable and washed-out CLOSED bridge in distant background; cozy daytime, no battle, no danger animations. Main board should be clear and readable.
Exactly SIX principal draggable human wooden tokens in holding areas at LEFT shore, organized into two rows of three: THREE blue-clad patrol officers with star badge symbol, THREE orange/clay-clad detained road workers with spade symbol. All drawn humanely as adult travelers in frontier clothing, no weapons, no chains, no villain faces. All six currently left, RIGHT shore empty. Ferry empty with EXACTLY TWO large pale circular seat slots; do not put decorative people on ferry or right shore. Each of the six tokens clear large hit target, no other person tokens anywhere. Left heading “此岸 6 人” right heading “对岸 0 人”. Small badge “往返 0 次”. Distinct colors plus star/spade icons.
Right narrow parchment panel Milo portrait, label “米洛”; rules with legible succinct Chinese “小船最多坐 2 人” “有巡路员的一岸” “在押人数不能更多”. Bottom prominent light parchment strip “拖动上船 · 空格开船 · 右键撤回一步”. Top right “返回手帐 Esc”. Small secondary button “提示 H”. Bottom small “玩法概念 · 参数待试玩”. Subtle contextual objects folded corrected map, wellwater bottle, ruler. Physical materials painterly like existing game, lively but warm. Gameplay occupies at least 70 percent, not a collage or promotional poster. No hands, no UI neon, no photoreal modern policeman, no tiled map route, no weapons. Clear six-person count and two-seat boat are highest priority.
